inputs.text: SSANU has given the federal government one month to renegotiate the 2009 agreement with non-teaching university unions, warning of an indefinite nationwide strike if talks fail. It is telling that workers have to threaten disruption before their long-standing demands are treated as urgent: institutions depend on their labor, yet too often leave them without a fair hearing. The government should negotiate in good faith and reach a just agreement, rather than casting workers’ defense of their rights as the problem.
